Need versions; fetch full definitions.
The visual's measure traces to **INVOICELINES.EXTENDEDPRICE − INVOICELINES.TAXAMOUNT**, summed by **CUSTOMERS.CUSTOMERNAME**. It's on an invoice-date basis, tax is excluded and there are no filters. Every step below is backed by a source file. The gaps are listed at the end.

**Lineage**

| Step | Document (doc_id · path · version) | What it says |
|---|---|---|
| 1. Visual | CONNECTED_a5086dc0ef985e23 · fixtures/spotfire/customer_sales.metadata.json · 46742043d0c70b3e9492aca16f0c3fc04404c1db0bc14e334978b2674f172357 | Visual SYN_VIZ_CUSTOMER "Customer invoiced sales" uses data table InvoiceSales. Its category is `[CUSTOMERNAME]` and its value is `Sum([SalesAmount])`. The calculated column `SalesAmount = [INVOICED_SALES_EX_TAX]`. There are no filters, it uses all loaded dates and currency is null. |
| 2. Data table source | CONNECTED_1055b17d75582621 · fixtures/spotfire/customer_sales.source.sql · f67352b5a51bba4566da228ea9c31326007138b0e8e05aabca4de2686370f561 | Reads INVOICED_SALES_EX_TAX, CUSTOMERNAME, CUSTOMERID, INVOICEDATE and other columns directly from `"SYNTHETIC_SALES"."CV_INVOICE_SALES"`. |
| 3. HANA-style model | CONNECTED_c321fb5572f5ed86 · fixtures/hana/CV_INVOICE_SALES.model.xml · d33d0ec9211725e359b399623b46396df45aca42fac9800473bebb08cc061ce3 | One row per INVOICELINEID. `INVOICED_SALES_EX_TAX = l.EXTENDEDPRICE - l.TAXAMOUNT`, and `CUSTOMERNAME = c.CUSTOMERNAME`. Joins are inner and many-to-one: INVOICELINES.INVOICEID → INVOICES.INVOICEID, INVOICES.CUSTOMERID → CUSTOMERS.CUSTOMERID, INVOICELINES.STOCKITEMID → STOCKITEMS.STOCKITEMID. The model is marked `nativeDeploymentValidated="false"`. |
| 3b. SQL equivalent | CONNECTED_6f53633c096a6b56 · fixtures/hana/CV_INVOICE_SALES.sql · a6c9df764b8ddc66665021280bf87770130becbbb10d52e1796768f78a84fd3d | Same columns and joins as the XML model. It says it is not an SAP deployment artifact. |
| Business rule | CONNECTED_d6d252dc2b0538ee · Synthetic business: definitions.md | Invoiced sales = invoice-line ExtendedPrice minus TaxAmount, on invoice date. ExtendedPrice includes tax. (I took this from the search result only and didn't open the full file, so I don't have its path or version.) |

**Source-backed mappings**
- SalesAmount → CV_INVOICE_SALES.INVOICED_SALES_EX_TAX → INVOICELINES.EXTENDEDPRICE − INVOICELINES.TAXAMOUNT
- Category CUSTOMERNAME → CUSTOMERS.CUSTOMERNAME, reached through INVOICES.CUSTOMERID
- Date basis (used by the monthly visual and the definitions) → INVOICES.INVOICEDATE

**Missing or unsupported**
- **Physical location of the tables:** the model names INVOICELINES, INVOICES, CUSTOMERS and STOCKITEMS without a database or schema. A different report, "Customer invoiced sales" (CUSTOMER_INVOICE_SALES), reads from `HACKATHON_D2K_PREWORK.RAW.*`. That doesn't show that CV_INVOICE_SALES points at the same tables.
- **Customer grouping:** the visual groups by customer name only, not by CUSTOMERID. Two customers with the same name would be combined into one bar.
- **Deployment:** all of these files are normalized synthetic fixtures, not real Spotfire or HANA exports, and none has been checked against a running system.
- **Extra inner join:** the STOCKITEMS join isn't needed for this measure. Any invoice line whose product has no STOCKITEMS match would drop out of the total, and the documents don't say whether that ever happens.
